help.title: Parametric Survival Distribution Fit Analysis (Interval Censored)
help.body:
Description

Fits multiple parametric survival distributions to interval-censored data using Surv(Age_L, Age_U, type="interval2") and compares them by AIC (lower = better fit).

Censoring types handled
  • Exact failure: Age_L == Age_U
  • Interval-censored: Age_L < Age_U (both finite) — failure occurred between Age_L and Age_U
  • Right-censored: Age_U = Inf or NA — unit still running at Age_L
  • Left-censored: Age_L = 0, Age_U finite — failed before first inspection
Outputs
  • AIC comparison table — distributions ranked from best to worst fit
  • Survival curve with CI for the best-fitting distribution
  • Hazard curve with CI for the best-fitting distribution
  • Empirical vs Fitted Survival plot using the Turnbull nonparametric estimator as overlay (replaces Kaplan-Meier which requires exact times)
  • Optionally: MLE parameter table for every fitted distribution
Note on distribution names
flexsurvreg uses: weibull, exp, gamma, lognormal, loglogistic.
